answer: Each Sybil identity must harbor quadratic collateral c_i=i², with an ember of unbonded stake slashed per equivocation, so marginal cost C'(i)=2iλ exceeds linear extracted value βi for i>β/2λ. The resulting Nash equilibrium has no profitable unilateral Sybil deviation, as expected utility βi−λi²−μΔi<0 beyond the threshold.
